findings.description: Friedrich Carl Weber and Catharina Carell had a daughter, Anna Maria Eva Weber, born 26 February 1870 in Höchst, Hesse-Nassau — the couple's first known child, eleven months after their 7 February 1869 marriage.
supporting_sources: Deutschland, Hesse-Nassau, Diözese Limburg, Katholische Kirchenbücher, 1601-1919 — baptismal entry naming parents Karl Weber and Katharina Karell
